notes: *out of* is taken as מִן's own multi-word preposition, headed on *out* (rule 24), which leaves יָצָאתִי the bare *came I*.
שָׁמָּה → *thither* fuses the adverb with its directive he under rules 30 and 32.
אִמִּי is rendered attributively as an English possessive, which rule 28 follows rather than imposing rule 19.
Variant WLC.JOB.1.21.v003 is underdetermined and the projection's base reading of s004 is compatible with the ASV; no textual decision is made here (rule 9).
